verdicts.reason: A: the 'Shop Sale' button is shrunk until its text is barely legible, and it floats at the bottom right away from the copy, so the CTA is buried. The peach circle sits alone in the top-right corner, the bottle almost touches the top and bottom edges, and 'WEEKEND ONLY' has dropped from eyebrow to footer. B: the CTA is a properly sized pill on the text's vertical axis, layered on the circle the same way the original does it, so it reads left to right. Its flaws: 'WEEKEND ONLY' also moved below the body copy instead of leading it, the text block is a little tight against the CTA, and the bottle is cramped against the top edge.
